entries.reason: Extend the exact October4 review scope for the reproduced Windows job-drain race. Preserve all prior review records, original upstream lineage and the owner index.

Retain bounded job-membership polling when TerminateProcess loses a race with natural exit or a previous termination. Only a subsequent observation of the broker alone permits STOPPED; live members, failed queries and missing durable receipts remain failures. Three real child-process churn cases failed before this change and passed afterward, followed by the expanded native and Chrome checks. No timeout or proof requirement was weakened.
